external_entities.name: customer
external_entities.description: Customers who sign in and load the web application.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers sign in to our Auth0 identity provider

external_entities.name: Auth0 identity provider
external_entities.description: External identity provider used for customer sign-in and OAuth2 bearer tokens.
external_entities.source_excerpt: our Auth0 identity provider over HTTPS with TLS 1.3

external_entities.name: Stripe
external_entities.description: External payment service used for payment authorisation.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Payment authorisation goes to Stripe over HTTPS with a secret API key

external_entities.name: analytics team
external_entities.description: A group of internal analysts that queries the analytics bucket through Athena.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The analytics team, a group of internal analysts, query that bucket through Athena

external_entities.name: support administrator
external_entities.description: Staff who use the admin console to perform support operations.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Support administrators are staff who use an admin console on the Orders API

external_entities.name: platform team
external_entities.description: Team permitted to copy or restore database snapshots, the bucket, and the audit log.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore the database snapshots, the bucket and the audit log

processes.name: React single-page web app
processes.description: Public React single-page web application that calls the Orders API.

processes.name: CloudFront
processes.description: Serves the web application to the public internet and has AWS WAF request limiting applied.
processes.source_excerpt: CloudFront serves it to the public internet over HTTPS with TLS 1.3

processes.name: AWS WAF
processes.description: Limits each client to 2,000 requests per five minutes on CloudFront.
processes.source_excerpt: AWS WAF on CloudFront limits each client to 2,000 requests per five minutes

processes.name: Orders API
processes.description: Internal API that authenticates requests, reads and writes orders, processes support actions, and sends payment authorisation.
processes.source_excerpt: The web app calls an internal Orders API in our AWS VPC over HTTPS

processes.name: nightly batch job
processes.description: Nightly job that reads at most one day of orders and writes summaries to S3.
processes.source_excerpt: A nightly batch job in the VPC reads at most one day of orders over TLS

processes.name: Athena
processes.description: Query service used by the analytics team to query the S3 bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: query that bucket through Athena, which reads it over TLS

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: Administrative console on the Orders API used by support administrators.
processes.source_excerpt: Support administrators are staff who use an admin console on the Orders API

data_stores.name: Postgres database
data_stores.description: Database holding customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers, and order history.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It holds customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers, and order history

data_stores.name: S3 bucket
data_stores.description: KMS-encrypted bucket containing batch-job summaries queried by analytics.

data_stores.name: CloudWatch Logs audit log
data_stores.description: KMS-encrypted audit log receiving each administrative action; administrators cannot change it.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a KMS- encrypted CloudWatch Logs audit log that administrators cannot change

data_stores.name: database snapshots
data_stores.description: Database snapshots that only the platform team can copy or restore.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore the database snapshots

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Customer sign-in to the Auth0 identity provider using a password and MFA.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers sign in to our Auth0 identity provider over HTTPS with TLS 1.3, using a password and MFA

data_flows.name: load web app
data_flows.description: Customer loads the React single-page web application from CloudFront without signing in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Anyone can load our React single-page web app without signing in; CloudFront serves it to the public internet over HTTPS with TLS 1.3

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The web application calls the Orders API with an Auth0 OAuth2 bearer token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web app calls an internal Orders API in our AWS VPC over HTTPS. Every call carries an Auth0 OAuth2 bearer token

data_flows.name: read-write orders
data_flows.description: Orders API reads and writes the Postgres database using IAM database authentication.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The Orders API reads and writes a Postgres database in a private subnet over TLS, with IAM database authentication
data_flows.data_description: Customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers, and order history

data_flows.name: payment authorisation
data_flows.description: Orders API sends payment authorisation to Stripe using a secret API key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Payment authorisation goes to Stripe over HTTPS with a secret API key; card numbers never reach our systems
data_flows.data_description: Payment authorisation; card numbers do not reach our systems

data_flows.name: read orders
data_flows.description: Nightly batch job reads at most one day of orders using a read-only database role.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A nightly batch job in the VPC reads at most one day of orders over TLS with a read-only database role
data_flows.data_description: At most one day of orders

data_flows.name: write summaries
data_flows.description: Nightly batch job writes summaries to the KMS-encrypted S3 bucket using its own IAM role.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes summaries over HTTPS, with its own IAM role, to a KMS-encrypted S3 bucket

data_flows.name: query bucket
data_flows.description: Analytics team queries the bucket through Athena.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The analytics team, a group of internal analysts, query that bucket through Athena

data_flows.name: read summaries
data_flows.description: Athena reads the S3 bucket over TLS using read-only IAM roles.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Athena, which reads it over TLS, with read- only IAM roles

data_flows.name: administer orders
data_flows.description: Support administrators use the admin console to refund orders, edit delivery addresses, and look up order history.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Through it they refund orders, edit delivery addresses, and look up order history
data_flows.data_description: Refunds, delivery addresses, and order history

data_flows.name: support actions
data_flows.description: Support administrators use the admin console on the Orders API over HTTPS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Support administrators are staff who use an admin console on the Orders API from a corporate management network over HTTPS, signing in with SSO and MFA
data_flows.notes: The text describes the administrators using the admin console on the Orders API; the console is represented separately as a process.

data_flows.name: write audit actions
data_flows.description: Orders API writes each administrative action to the CloudWatch Logs audit log using its IAM role.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API writes each action over HTTPS, with its IAM role, to a KMS- encrypted CloudWatch Logs audit log

data_flows.name: copy or restore snapshots
data_flows.description: Platform team copies or restores database snapshots through IAM roles with SSO and MFA.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore the database snapshots, the bucket and the audit log, through IAM roles with SSO and MFA over HTTPS
data_flows.authentication: IAM roles with SSO and MFA

data_flows.name: copy or restore bucket
data_flows.description: Platform team copies or restores the S3 bucket through IAM roles with SSO and MFA.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore the database snapshots, the bucket and the audit log, through IAM roles with SSO and MFA over HTTPS
data_flows.authentication: IAM roles with SSO and MFA

data_flows.name: copy or restore audit log
data_flows.description: Platform team copies or restores the audit log through IAM roles with SSO and MFA.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore the database snapshots, the bucket and the audit log, through IAM roles with SSO and MFA over HTTPS
data_flows.authentication: IAM roles with SSO and MFA
